items.title: An AI-generated daily quiz app I built on my bike
items.raw_excerpt: Not a startup attempt, just a weekend project for my family. My parents do a daily quiz, but the site they use looks like it was built in 1999 and not touched since. I thought it’d be a fun excuse to rebuild something simple and leverage AI for automation. The app uses 5 agents to generate a 10 question general knowledge quiz, daily, with loose association to a random topic. It also allows for user generated quizzes based on a provided topic. Side note: I built the majority of it whilst riding my indoor bike. Claude Code + WisprFlow is insanely good these days.

Author: Bao Yonggang  Editor: Lin Juemin  
Midwinter in Beijing carries a slight chill, but the venue of Moore Threads' first developer conference (MDC) was buzzing with energy. The 1,000-square-meter exhibition area gathered over a thousand developers, who focused on cutting-edge technologies like intelligent robots, digital humans, and Agents, while also discussing advanced applications such as AI for Science and weather forecasting.  
The digital entertainment and video multimedia zone at the center of the exhibition area was the most eye-catching: some were immersed in controlling the eVTOL full-motion flight simulator, while others were engaged in intense battles in classic fighting games like King of Fighters and AAA titles powered by domestic GPUs. "We might be the only ones in China currently capable of showcasing Street Fighter games," an engineer noted, highlighting Moore Threads' rarity in possessing graphical capabilities alongside AI computing power among its peers.  
If one only learns about Moore Threads—one of the few domestic companies developing full-feature GPUs—through text or videos, it might remain an abstract concept. Being at the exhibition, with ten GPU application cases displayed at once, is enough to convey part of the GPU's value. But when nearly a hundred applications are showcased simultaneously, the impact is twofold: on one hand, it offers an intuitive understanding of the capabilities of a full-feature GPU; on the other, all these applications come from a domestic GPU company that is just five years old.  
Moore Threads translates the capabilities of its full-feature GPU into a wide range of applications spanning from consumer to vertical industries, and from graphics to AI and high-performance computing. This not only concretely demonstrates its unique value but also allows people to tangibly experience it.

Autor｜Bao Yonggang Editor｜Lin Juemin  
A mediados del invierno, Pekín tiene un ligero frío, pero el ambiente en la sede de la primera Conferencia de Desarrolladores de Moore Threads (MDC) es muy cálido. En una zona de exposición de 1.000 metros cuadrados se reúnen más de mil desarrolladores, interesados en tecnologías de vanguardia como robots inteligentes, humanos digitales y agentes, y también debaten sobre aplicaciones avanzadas como IA para la ciencia y predicciones meteorológicas.  
La zona central de entretenimiento digital y multimedia es la más llamativa: algunos se sumergen en la experiencia de control del simulador de vuelo completo eVTOL, mientras otros libran intensas batallas en mundos de juegos clásicos como "The King of Fighters" y títulos AAA impulsados por GPU nacionales. "Actualmente, quizás solo yo puedo exhibir juegos como Street Fighter en el país".
